Name: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Standard 2013
Description: ISO (the International Organization for Standardization) and IEC (the International Electrotechnical Commission) form the specialized system for worldwide standardization. National bodies that are members of ISO or IEC participate in the development of International Standards through technical committees established by the respective organization to deal with particular fields of technical activity. ISO and IEC technical committees collaborate in fields of mutual interest. Other international organizations, governmental and non-governmental, in liaison with ISO and IEC, also take part in the work.

Checks.name: Require Numbers in IAM Passwords
Checks.description: Checks whether the IAM password policy requires at least one numeric character in each password.

Requirements.Description: Ensure IAM password policy require at least one symbol
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure IAM password policy require at least one symbol

Checks.name: Require Symbols in IAM Passwords
Checks.description: Checks whether the IAM password policy requires at least one symbol in each password.

Requirements.Description: Ensure IAM password policy require at least one lowercase letter
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure IAM password policy require at least one lowercase letter

Checks.name: Require Lowercase Characters in IAM Passwords
Checks.description: Checks whether the IAM password policy requires at least one lowercase character in each password.

Requirements.Description: Ensure IAM password policy requires at least one uppercase letter
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure IAM password policy requires at least one uppercase letter

Checks.name: Require Uppercase Characters in IAM Passwords
Checks.description: Checks whether the IAM password policy requires at least one uppercase character in each password.

Requirements.Description: Avoid the use of the 'root' account
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Avoid the use of the 'root' account

Checks.name: Avoid Using the AWS Root User for Routine Tasks
Checks.description: Evaluates the AWS account root identity and IAM account settings against the benchmark objective “Avoid the use of the 'root' account.” It helps identify configuration gaps that could weaken identity security and least-privilege enforcement.

Requirements.Description: Ensure IAM policies are attached only to groups or roles
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure IAM policies are attached only to groups or roles

Checks.name: Grant IAM User Permissions Through Groups or Roles
Checks.description: Evaluates the IAM policy against the benchmark objective “Ensure IAM policies are attached only to groups or roles.” It helps identify configuration gaps that could weaken identity security and least-privilege enforcement.

Requirements.Description: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have console access
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have console access

Checks.name: Require MFA for IAM Users with Console Access
Checks.description: Checks whether IAM users who can sign in to the console are protected by multi-factor authentication.

Requirements.Description: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' account
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' account

Checks.name: Require MFA for the AWS Root User
Checks.description: Checks whether MFA protects the AWS root identity, adding a second authentication factor to the account's most privileged identity.

Requirements.Description: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less

Checks.name: Rotate IAM Access Keys Within 90 Days
Checks.description: Evaluates the IAM user against the benchmark objective “Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less.” It helps identify configuration gaps that could weaken identity security and least-privilege enforcement.

Requirements.Description: Ensure credentials unused for 90 days or greater are disabled
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure credentials unused for 90 days or greater are disabled

Checks.name: Disable or Remove Unused IAM Access Keys
Checks.description: Checks IAM access-key activity to identify keys that have not been used within the applicable period and should be disabled or removed after validation.

Checks.name: Disable Unused IAM Console Credentials
Checks.description: Checks console credential usage to identify IAM users with unused interactive access that should be reviewed and disabled when no longer required.

Requirements.Description: Ensure no root account access key exists
Requirements.Name: System and Application Access Control

Attributes.Check_Summary: Ensure no root account access key exists

Checks.name: Ensure the AWS Root User Has No Access Keys
Checks.description: Checks whether the AWS root identity has active programmatic access keys, which can provide highly privileged access outside normal role-based controls.
